title: EntityId
description: Canonical wire form of choirloom::score::EntityId - a nominal, opaque 128-bit generic persistent entity identity (ScoreIR and GeometryGraph own separate identity spaces; cross-layer links are explicit and equal IDs never imply cross-layer correspondence). Lower-case UUIDv4-compatible string; persistent identity only (no ordering, no content hash, no container index/address/rowid, no MusicXML/OMR/WinUI coupling). DRAFT / NON-FROZEN. Two-level validation: this schema enforces the syntactic pattern only; non-nil, exact 16-byte, and version/variant semantics are enforced by the core (EntityId::from_string / EntityId::from_bytes).
